utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely — I’ll spread the word to a few more neighbors right away. The more hands, the better for the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late as usual, but I can still help out. I’ll bring whatever tape or spare nails I can find.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Dane — bring what you can and come on by. I’ll keep spreading the word so we get a few more hands too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—4 works for me. Just let me know if the repair drive location changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Eli — I only heard bits second-hand, so I’m still catching up. Do you know if they need any other tools or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m not sure yet, but I can check if they need anything else. If you hear of a list, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 9 works for me—I can coordinate around the school schedule. Let me know what supplies or boxes you still need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sounds fine, but can you confirm where the drop-off is and what boxes you still need? I’d like the details nailed down before I bring anything.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still waiting on the exact drop-off spot, but I can bring any spare boxes we need. Once you confirm the location, I’ll make sure it fits around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive today. I’ll try to swing by later if I remember.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve been keeping an eye on the supplies, so if you need anything just tell me and I’ll check what we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — I might forget otherwise. If you’ve got a spare wrench or tape, I’ll just grab whatever’s easiest when I swing by.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still in, I just want to make sure the drop-off spot is confirmed first. Do we know exactly where the repair drive is collecting everything?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m still planning to swing by, and I’ll check on the exact drop-off spot too. I’ll remind the others about the tools and supplies as well.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — once you know the exact drop-off spot, can you let me know? I just want to make sure I can get everything there on time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? Last I heard, it’s coming together nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you want, I can ask around for any fresh details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — could you ask what items are still needed and when the repair drive is happening?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll ask around about what’s still needed and when it’s happening. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you get a chance to check what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I haven’t checked yet, sorry—I’m a bit forgetful, but I can ask around and see what they still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, that helps. Can you ask around and let me know what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m putting the repair drive details on the community hall bulletin board. If you need anything specific, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Bo — I’m still in. Could you confirm the exact drop-off spot at the community hall and whether there’s a time window for bringing things by?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep—drop things off at the community hall bulletin board area, and anytime during the day should be fine.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got it now: the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center. I’ll note that down and help keep the details straight.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks, Opal — Sunday at the community center works. I’ll help spread the word and point folks to the bulletin board if they have questions.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ll keep Sunday at the community center as the official spot and note the bulletin board for questions.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That’d be great, thanks. Let’s start with the edge cracks first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — let’s start with the edge cracks first, and we’ll do it Sunday at the community center. I’ll make sure everyone has the updated plan.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good, Rosa. I’ll be there Sunday and I’ll bring my tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I can help a little, but I’ll need to keep it simple right now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds fine — simple is good. I can still help spread the word a little if you want.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey — that’d help a lot. I’ll try to come by Sunday at the community center when I can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that repair drive? I heard it’s picking up a few more donations than expected. I’ll let you know if I hear they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — just let me know if anything’s still needed, and I can bring my tools over.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Gus — if I hear they still need tools or supplies, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got the screwdrivers, hammer, duct tape, and a few sturdy boxes ready to drop off for the repair drive. If you still need anything else, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Gus—those tools will really help. I’ll remind the others about the repair drive and see if anyone can bring a few more supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks, Vik—much appreciated. I’ll bring these by soon, and if you spot any other gaps, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is starting soon. If you want, I can help spread the word a little.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey — could you tell me what still needs fixing and when the drive starts? I’m happy to help once I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure on the exact list or start time yet, but I can ask around and pass it along once I know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly the cracks near the edge — if you’ve got any filler or patch mix, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can bring some patch mix and filler for the repair drive. If you want, I can also help coordinate who’s dropping things off.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That’d be great, Mara. Patch mix first, and coordination would help too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can bring over some filler and patch mix later today, and we can check the edge cracks before we start.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late as usual, but I can still help out. I’ll bring whatever tape or spare nails I can find.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be great, Dane — the tape and spare nails should come in handy. Just swing by when you can, and we’ll patch things up together.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — I’m happy to help connect folks. What do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, what time is the repair drive happening and where should people drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m checking the final time now, but the drop-off will be at the community hall bulletin board for the notes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, the community hall bulletin board is fine for the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll note the repair drive for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, Sunday at the community center works for me.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? It’s coming together nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you need the details, I can ask around.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — I’d appreciate that. I only caught bits of it, so I’d love to know what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll ask around and see what they still need, then I’ll let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you get a chance to check what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I heard they’re getting a few more donations than expected. I’ll let you know if I hear they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, please do—just let me know if there’s anything I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m telling everyone about it — the repair drive sounds like a great idea. I’ll spread the word around the neighborhood right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s great, Quinn — thank you. I’ll ask around too and pass along anything they still need so we can keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and let people know to check what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Uli—thank you. Just come by on Sunday at the community center and do whatever feels manageable for you.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll come by Sunday when I can and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Uli—thank you. We’ll be glad to have you there whenever you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: What time is the repair drive happening? I can work around the school schedule once I know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 4 works for me. Just let me know if the repair drive location changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4 works for me too—I’ll work around the school schedule. Just let me know if the location changes.
